extracted.name: Islander cocktail
extracted.description: Try this sophisticated cocktail for your next summer gathering with friends. Mix up dark rum, smoky mezcal, fruity lime and grapefruit with cocoa bitters
ingredient_lines: seaweed or kelp powder to garnish (optional)
instruction_lines: Rim a coupette glass with salt and seaweed, if using. Fill a cocktail shaker with the ice and then add all the remaining ingredients. Shake well to combine, until the mixture is chilled. Double strain into the glass.
